notes: Total 60 as published (section counts match; the Objective and Epic Duel are listed above the sections).

Starting cards as posted under 'This is the start': Hunt Down (the Objective), Epic Duel, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points, plus 'one effect depending on what opponent is playing' (Resistance vs EBO, Battle Plan vs Hidden Base, Crush The Rebellion vs Throne Room/Profit per the strategy). Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'Cloud City Docking Bay' dested the Dark Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Death Star Docking Bay 327' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Officer Evax (Japanese - it kicks ass)' Officer Evax (the Japanese-language printing; same card); 'ECC IG-88 w/ Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun and 'ECC 4-Lom w/ Gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (the Enhanced Cloud City cards); 'Come Here You Coward' Come Here You Big Coward; 'Hell to Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Visage' the Death Star II Effect Visage Of The Emperor; 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Boba Fett in Slave 1' Boba Fett In Slave I.

Resistance, Secret Plans, Battle Order and Come Here You Big Coward are the older Effects (not the Reflections III shields). The strategy names Battle Plan as the start vs Hidden Base (Battle Plan is a Light card and not in this list); not added.
The description says the deck is 'like 13-1' for the player; no event is named, so it is filed as general.
